source: client NpcData skills + Skill.dat cast times and cooldowns (world-npcs.json) for the rotation; the CC abnormals (knockdown 2 s on 1601110, stun 2.5 s on 1601150) are the client's own NPC skill abnormals (ported-skill-abnormals.json) and match the guide's game-file list (MB-x eternal-gartua). Odyle Absorption: client cast 15 s and self abnormal 12000063 (PhysicDamageRatio / MagicDamageRatio +2000, read as +20%: the unit is a GUESS). The interval and the length of the buff are GUESSES.
